description: Official auctions are archived. Current auction searches and details are unavailable. Search published official real-estate auctions without a catalog ID. Up to 24 per page; follow nextPage. Every call rechecks source publication, permission, freshness and current status. Coverage is partial. startingBid is the opening bid, minimumBid the minimum accepted offer, valuation an appraisal and deposit security; never substitute them or convert currency.

country.description: Exact uppercase assigned ISO country code; inventory and source coverage may be partial.

page.description: Page of at most 24 published auctions; defaults to 1. Follow nextPage.

q.description: Public title/location keyword, at most 120 UTF-16 code units before trimming; blank is omitted.

name: search_auctions
